post.summary: Apply a device's outbox, in order
post.description: Each op runs through the same action as a normal API call. A repeated opId returns `duplicate` without writing again. One op failing doesn't stop the rest. Answers the first 6 ops; send the others again (D-050).

200.description: One result per answered op, same order

results.description: One result per op, in order, for the first 6 ops. Ops after those get no result and were not applied: send them again.

post.summary: The assistant asks to run an action: it runs, or becomes a confirm card
post.description: studio-assistant only. Runs the action if the studio lets the assistant do it alone; otherwise stores a confirm card for the person and returns it. Edits and deletes may leave out `version`: the current one is used, and the card fails with 409 if the record changes before the tap.

post.summary: Confirm a card: run what it says, as the assistant, on your say-so
post.description: A person only, never the assistant. Runs the action with the input the card shows. A second tap returns the first result. Undo with POST /activity/{activityIds[0]}/undo.

get.summary: The tools the assistant gets in one app, from the action registry
get.description: Only actions tagged for the app (all of them for app=studio), that the caller's role allows and the studio hasn't set to never. Sorted, so the list is stable for prompt caching.

get.summary: The current conversation, on any device
get.description: A new thread starts after 4 quiet hours or 40 messages; the messages come back exactly as stored, so the model sees an unedited history. With fresh=1: a new, empty thread (the panel's New conversation); it becomes current once its first turn is stored. With id: that past conversation of mine (continuing it makes it current again).
